en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a densely forested mountainous landscape. In the distance a rounded mountain rises above dark conifer woods, with a cleared swath or path running up its slope and a small structure or tower at the summit. On the right, a rocky outcrop drops into the forest, and along the far ridge a small village or scattered houses are visible. The image is framed by a light border with handwritten-style German captions along the bottom.
